draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.46, the 15th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 2nd of 32 at WR. He went 22nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Travis Benjamin. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,077 receiving yards in 2022, 8th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Baltimore Ravens. 50 career games and 48 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (14 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: team target share 29.0% (98th percentile), approximate value 14 (98th percentile), receiving yards 1,211 (96th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 wide receiver who played: 1,211 receiving yards against a median of 346, above the norm.
